test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

After travelling for 2 days straight, Reema was too _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**knackered**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Knackered**" means extremely tired or exhausted. (अत्यधिक थका हुआ या थका हुआ)
 
• It is a commonly used informal term in British English.
 
• The word is derived from "knacker", which refers to someone who disposes of old or injured horses.
 
 
• **For example**: *Reema was too knackered to even unpack her bags after her long journey.*
 
 

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

**Complete sentence**: *After travelling for 2 days straight, Reema was too knackered__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "**worried**", does not fit the context as there is no indication of Reema being worried in the given sentence. (चिंतित)
 
• Option 3, "**adjured**", means to urge or advise someone earnestly, which does not make sense in the given sentence. (किसी से आग्रह या सलाह देना)
 
• Option 4, "**deferred**", means to postpone or delay something, which is not relevant to Reema's state after travelling. (किसी बात को स्थगित या विलंबित करना)
